name: 48629 · Houghton Lake, MI
findings: ZIP 48629 (Houghton Lake) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48629 (Houghton Lake) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
